description: Use when someone is choosing or buying a LIS, LIMS, POCT middleware or an analyzer-to-EHR interface and wants an RFP or a list of questions to ask vendors (e.g. 'what should I ask LIS vendors?', 'RFP questions for lab middleware', 'checklist for buying an HL7 interface'). Returns a copyable, vendor-neutral checklist grouped by connectivity, QC and compliance, security and privacy, data and audit trail, implementation and support, pricing, and contract and exit.

buying.description: What they are buying. Default any.

groups.description: Only these groups. Omit for all.

name: vendor_questions
title: Questions to ask when buying a LIS, middleware or lab interface
